note: Pinned ocrs model files for the `ocrs` engine of tpe-image-text; fetched by crates/tpe-image-text/fetch-models.sh into .models/ocrs/ (see docs/IMAGE_TEXT.md). Keep one entry object per line: fetch-models.sh falls back to a line-oriented reader when python3 is absent. The engine refuses a file whose size or sha256 differs from this manifest; the URLs are the ones ocrs itself downloads from and are unversioned, so the digest is the identity.
